# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 111 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 111 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_111_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 10, Chapter 1

**1** After I had written down the commandments and similitudes of the shepherd, the angel of repentance, he came to me and said, "I want to show you all the things which the Holy Spirit, who spoke with you in the form of the church, showed to you; for that Spirit is the Son of God. **2** But since you were weak in flesh, it was not declared to you through an angel; but when you were strengthened through the Spirit and became powerful in strength so that you could see an angel also, then was the building of the tower made manifest to you through the church; and you saw all things well and reverently, not frightened by an angel." **3** After a few days I saw the Glorius One. He said to me: "What do you seek?" **4** I said to him, "Lord, command the shepherd, the angel of repentance, to depart from my house." **5** "He shall remain with you," he said, "as long as you live." **6** "But why?" I asked. **7** "Because," he said, "the Lord saw your innocence and simplicity; and the Lord set great store by your simplicity and your innocence; and therefore I was sent to dwell with you always, that you might be on your guard against all wickedness and act in righteousness." **8** "But, Lord," I said, "I am greatly honoured by your presence and your company." **9** "You say well; but your companions must also be watchful, for those who are with you shall be of great benefit to you." **10** "When then, Lord," I said, "will the tower be built?" "It is being built," he said, "as you see; for at this hour, all these things which you see are being accomplished."

---

*EMET: Similitude 10 opens with a restatement of the christological and pneumatological framework. The Shepherd will remain with Hermas for life — a permanent angelic companion representing the call to repentance.*
